name: Кинематографический реализм
about: Цифровая живопись с весом фотографии: свет всегда мотивирован источником внутри кадра, диапазон до истинного чёрного, мазок виден на металле и ткани, а обжитый хлам — кружки, бумажки, потёртые панели — выписан наравне с техникой.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge
palette_en: Low key: roughly three quarters of the frame sits in deep shadow and near-black is the largest area in the picture; light claims only what its sources directly reach. Colour comes from those sources — warm amber and sodium — against shadow that stays a cold steel-blue rather than turning brown.
